# @neural-ng/core/date-picker

Angular 22+ standalone, Signal-first DatePicker and TimePicker.
STATUS: beta

IMPORT
import { NeuralDatePicker } from '@neural-ng/core/date-picker';
- NeuralDatePicker is canonical. DatePickerComponent is deprecated compatibility only.

BASIC
<neural-date-picker [(value)]="date" />

VALUE RULES
- Never use JavaScript Date as the component model.
- Use NeuralDateParts: { year, month, day }.
- Use NeuralTimeParts: { hour, minute, second, millisecond }.
- Use NeuralDateTimeParts: { date, time }.
- selectionMode="range" uses NeuralDateRange.
- selectionMode="multiple" uses readonly NeuralDateParts[].
- pickerMode is date, month, year, time, or datetime.

FORMS
- DatePicker implements FormValueControl.
- Use [formControl], [(ngModel)], or [formField] directly.
- Do not add a ControlValueAccessor wrapper or second value store.
- Preserve disabled, readonly, required, invalid, touched, dirty, and touch.

EVENTS
- valueChange is model synchronization.
- selectionChange and selected describe user selection.
- cleared contains the previous value.
- opened and closed describe rendered panel lifecycle.
- viewChanged, monthChanged, and yearChanged describe navigation.
- invalidInput reports field, raw input, and format/range reason.
- Do not invent onSelect, onChange, onDateSelect, or onClose outputs.

CONSTRAINTS
- Compose minDate, maxDate, disabledDates, disabledDays, dateFilter, and
  isDateDisabled. Do not pre-filter the rendered calendar externally.
- Today and Clear commit immediately unless unavailable.
- showApplyActions enables draft Apply/Cancel behavior.
- Time and datetime always use a draft.

LOCALE AND ACCESSIBILITY
- Prefer NeuralLocaleService; use [locale] only for a component override.
- firstDayOfWeek may explicitly override the locale.
- Preserve dialog/grid semantics, roving tabindex, keyboard navigation, focus
  restoration, aria-live view announcements, full weekday labels, and RTL.
- Use parseNeuralLocaleDate for deterministic text parsing. Do not use
  Date.parse or browser-dependent parsing.

OVERLAY
- Do not add appendTo="body". DatePicker uses NeuralNg Popover and the browser
  top layer without moving Angular-owned DOM.
- Keep SSR closed and browser positioning hydration-safe.

HEADLESS
- unstyled removes visual *-base classes, never structural *-root hooks.
- Use NeuralDatePickerClasses for typed slots.
- Preserve structural -> component tokens -> theme -> consumer class order.
- Use the six exported neuralDatePicker* typed template directives for custom
  day, header, footer, trigger, previous, and next rendering.
